name: Projects
summary: One screen over what this Studio has: the agents on this machine, the apps installed here, and the files in your workspace. Each pane reads shallow and hands off to the app that does the job.

surface.hint: agents, apps and files at a glance; a reference app, written to be forked

_calls_note: Everything else this page reads (/api/factory/state, /api/contract, /surfaces.json) is served by the Studio runtime itself, so it needs no provider. /api/files/tree is answered by the Files provider when Files is installed, and by the runtime otherwise; it is optional for the same reason.
